why: SamplingMode selects Gamry Fast/NoiseReject/Surface per-step sampling (Surface for Cdl/ECSA); versus_OCV applies potentials relative to a pre-measured OCV, as run_PEIS does. All default to the previous behaviour. previous_ocv__V (2026-11-20) adds a preceding OCV action's Ewe_V__mean_final, copied in by the orchestrator, to every potential, so a CV in the same experiment as its OCV gets the ecms3 ECSA reference; defaults to the previous behaviour (versus_previous_OCV must be set for the shift; CV-only; existing CV records now carry previous_ocv__V: null and versus_previous_OCV: false).
SamplingMode selects Gamry Fast/NoiseReject/Surface per-step sampling; versus_OCV applies potentials relative to a pre-measured OCV, as run_PEIS does. All default to the previous behaviour.
versus_OCV applies the hold potential relative to a pre-measured OCV, as run_PEIS does. Defaults to the previous behaviour.
versus_OCV applies the RCA signal array relative to a pre-measured OCV, as run_PEIS does. Defaults to the previous behaviour.
allow_empty lets a liquid-only sample be added to an untouched empty custom position (ANEC flush-fill, a9337d5f). Defaults to the previous behaviour, which keeps the NoneSample guard.
